description: Get stablecoins with circulating supply (on-chain supply minus the issuer’s own stock), USD value at one unit of the peg currency and net change of circulating over 7 and 30 days, in whole US dollars. The 30 largest coins, the totals per chain and the total USD value of all stablecoins per day over the last 30 days. Pass a chain to count one chain only.

chain.description: Optional chain id: ethereum, tron, solana, base, arbitrum, bnb, …

name: get_stablecoins
title: Stablecoins: Supply and Flows
